name: Alchemist Aspirant
source: Pathfinder #160: Assault on Hunting Lodge Seven

items.name: Rapier
items.description: The rapier is a long and thin piercing blade with a basket hilt. It is prized among many as a dueling weapon.

items.name: Acid Flask (Moderate)
items.description:
Activate A Strike

This flask filled with corrosive acid deals 1 acid damage, 2d6 persistent acid damage, and 2 acid splash damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Alchemist's Fire (Moderate)
items.description:
Activate A Strike

Alchemist's fire is a combination of volatile liquids that ignite when exposed to air. Alchemist's fire deals 2d8 fire damage, 2 persistent fire damage, and 2 fire splash damage. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls.

items.name: Tanglefoot Bag (Moderate)
items.description:
Activate 1 Strike

A tanglefoot bag is filled with sticky substances. When you hit a creature with a tanglefoot bag, that creature takes a -15-foot status penalty to its Speeds for 1 minute. You gain a +1 item bonus to attack rolls, and the Escape DC is 19 ([[/act escape dc=19]]).

On a critical hit, a creature in contact with a solid surface becomes stuck to the surface and @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.Immobilized] for 1 round, and a creature flying via wings has its wings tangled, causing it to fall safely to the ground and become unable to Fly again for 1 round. Tanglefoot bags are not effective when used on a creature that is in water.

The target can end any effects by Escaping or spending a total of 3 actions to carefully remove the sticky substances. These Interact actions don't have to be consecutive, and other creatures can provide the actions as well.

items.name: +1 Studded Leather Armor
items.description: This leather armor is reinforced with metal studs and sometimes small metal plates, providing most of the flexibility of leather armor with more robust protection.

items.name: Alchemist Goggles
items.description:
These brass goggles are engraved with flame patterns and have thick, heavy lenses.

While worn, they give you a +1 item bonus to Crafting checks to Craft alchemical items and a +1 item bonus to attack rolls with alchemical bombs.

You can also ignore lesser cover when making Strikes with alchemical bombs.

items.name: Alchemist's Tools
items.description: This mobile collection of vials and chemicals can be used for simple alchemical tasks.

items.name: Formula Book
items.description:
A formula book holds the formulas necessary to make items other than the common equipment from this chapter; alchemists typically get one for free. Each formula book can hold the formulas for up to 100 different items. Formulas can also appear on parchment sheets, tablets, and almost any other medium; there's no need for you to copy them into a specific book as long as you can keep them on hand to reference them.

Contains formulas for the following:

  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Acid Flask (Moderate)]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Alchemist's Fire (Moderate)]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Antidote (Greater)]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Bravo's Brew (Moderate)]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Elixir of Life (Moderate)]
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Glue Bomb (Moderate)]{Tanglefoot Bag (Moderate)}
  • @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.equipment-srd.Item.Wyvern Poison]

defensiveAbilities.name: Infused Items
defensiveAbilities.description: Japu carries the following infused items, which last 24 hours or until the next time he makes his daily preparations: infused moderate acid flasks (2), infused moderate alchemist's fires (2), moderate elixirs of life (2), infused reagents (6), infused moderate tanglefoot bags (2).

offensiveAbilities.name: Alchemical Formulas (10th)
offensiveAbilities.description: moderate acid flask, moderate alchemist's fire, greater antidote, moderate bravo's brew, moderate elixir of life, moderate tanglefoot bag, wyvern poison

offensiveAbilities.name: Expanded Splash
offensiveAbilities.description: Japu's bombs that have the splash trait deal 5 splash damage and splash to 10 feet.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Alchemy
offensiveAbilities.description:
Cost 1 batch of infused reagents

Effect Japu creates a single alchemical item from his formula book (see Alchemical Formulas). This item has the infused trait, but it remains potent only until the end of his next turn.

offensiveAbilities.name: Quick Bomber
offensiveAbilities.description: Japu Interacts to draw a bomb then Strikes with it.
